_comment: Status-tint ratchet ceiling — the count of inline `color-mix(` occurrences under web/src/pages, measured by countInlineColorMix() in statusTint.test.ts. It may only SHRINK: a new hand-rolled tint turns CI red, and each migration to ui/StatusPill lowers this number IN THE SAME COMMIT. Keep it at the measured actual and BRACKET rather than assume — a ceiling of 177 fails with 'expected 178 to be less than or equal to 177', so the live count is exactly 178. Slack is not a safety margin here, it is a hole: one unit of it lands the next new inline tint green and unrecorded (`primitiveAdoption.baseline.json` records that hole absorbing a real regression). 179 -> 178 (bugfix-stale-search-binding): settings/SearchPanel.tsx's provider-state chip needed a THIRD state, `not installed`, and the row hand-rolled the 16% tint + ink pair twice; both toned states now ride the primitive, so the file went 2 -> 0 while gaining a state. `not configured` stayed a local span on purpose — a solid surface fill is a neutral GROUND, not a tone tint, which is the same split settings/bento.tsx draws and design/primitiveShadowing.test.ts pins. The remaining SearchPanel mix is the selected row's 12% primary fill, a selection ground this ratchet's own header names as legitimately non-pill. 178 -> 177: three hand-rolled 10% tints landed after that (the agent's unavailable-model note, its hooks-waiting note, and the attachment chip, whose inline style only repeated its own `bg-primary/10`), taking the live count to 180. All three moved to the theme's toned-fill utilities (`bg-warn/10`, `bg-primary/10`), which paint the same 10% of the same semantic token and which the pages already use for exactly this; none of the three is a pill, so StatusPill was not the home. Bracketed again: a ceiling of 176 fails with 'expected 177 to be less than or equal to 176'.
